Write {"file_path":"D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\features\core\freelance-jobs.feature","content":"Feature: Freelance Jobs Management

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getFreelanceJobs is called, the client shall return jobs with pagination cursors
    Given publicly available freelance jobs exist in the system
    When getFreelanceJobs is called
    Then the client shall return jobs with pagination cursors

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getFreelanceJobs returns no results, the client shall return an empty listing
    Given no freelance jobs exist in the system
    When getFreelanceJobs is called for the empty listing
    Then the client shall return an empty listing

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getFreelanceJobById is called, the client shall return the full job information
    Given a valid freelance job ID is provided
    When getFreelanceJobById is called
    Then the client shall return the full job information

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF the freelance job ID does not exist, THEN the client shall throw a not-found error
    Given a freelance job ID that does not exist
    When getFreelanceJobById is called for the non-existent job
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 404 for the job

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCharacterFreelanceJobs is called, the client shall return the character jobs with cursors
    Given an authenticated character with freelance jobs is available
    When getCharacterFreelanceJobs is called
    Then the client shall return the character jobs with cursors

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCharacterFreelanceJobParticipation is called, the client shall return contribution data
    Given a character participating in a freelance job is available
    When getCharacterFreelanceJobParticipation is called
    Then the client shall return the contribution data

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCorporationFreelanceJobs is called, the client shall return the corporation jobs listing
    Given an authenticated corporation for freelance jobs is available
    When getCorporationFreelanceJobs is called
    Then the client shall return the corporation jobs listing

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getFreelanceJobs is called with an after cursor, the client shall return the next page
    Given a first page with an after cursor is available
    When getFreelanceJobs is called with the after token
    Then the client shall return the second page of results

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getFreelanceJobs is called with a before cursor, the client shall return the previous page
    Given a second page with a before cursor is available
    When getFreelanceJobs is called with the before token
    Then the client shall return the first page of results

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF the token is invalid for character freelance jobs, THEN the client shall throw a forbidden error
    Given an invalid token for freelance jobs is provided
    When getCharacterFreelanceJobs is called with the invalid token
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 403 for freelance jobs
"}
